description: This file defines a final class DoctrineQuery within the OrangeHRM system, extending Doctrine's AbstractQuery, and provides methods for executing queries and retrieving SQL, though the implementations are placeholders throwing exceptions.

classes.name: DoctrineQuery
classes.description: A final class extending Doctrine's AbstractQuery, intended for executing database queries with custom behavior.
